interface.signature: def minStepToReachTarget(KnightPos: List[int], TargetPos: List[int], N: int) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(KnightPos, list) and len(KnightPos) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in KnightPos)
preconditions.description: KnightPos is a list of two integers.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(TargetPos, list) and len(TargetPos) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in TargetPos)
preconditions.description: TargetPos is a list of two integers.
KnightPos coordinates are within the bounds of the chessboard.
TargetPos coordinates are within the bounds of the chessboard.

postconditions.description: The return value is either the minimum number of steps or -1 if it's not possible.
